name: app-chat-list-and-thread-screens-with-empty-states
title: Four chat screens: conversation list, empty list, active thread and empty thread
whatItIs: Four phones titled 'Chat Screens — Conversation List & Messaging': a chat list with avatars, unread badges and media previews, an empty chat list with a faded placeholder and 'No Conversations Yet', a thread with purple sent and grey received bubbles, and an empty thread with only the header and composer.
whatItMeans: Complete and practical; pairing each screen with its empty state shows thoughtful design.
techniques: Design the empty state next to the full state.
Use faded placeholder rows as an empty illustration.
Keep a bottom tab bar consistent across screens.
Label each screen above the frame.

vocabulary.definition: What a screen shows when there is no content.
A small count bubble for new messages.
